purpose: Require a deterministic static HTML preflight that can be summarized directly in chat before LuHm front-end mutations are called good.
scope: dangerous DOM sinks embedded in HTML
requiredChatReceipt: visualProof=NOT_CLAIMED unless a real browser/device render was observed

statusSemantics.RED_STATIC_HTML: At least one static HTML guard failed.

hardRules: Static GREEN must never be described as visual/browser/device GREEN.
External URLs in HTML fail the local-first preflight unless a later explicit policy allows them.
Inline event handlers fail the preflight.
Dangerous HTML sinks fail the preflight.
Network primitives directly embedded in HTML fail the preflight.
jQuery must load before app.js for the current LuHm front-end contract.
